readinessDimensions.label: Foundation
readinessDimensions.summary: Positioning strengthened to 55% with formal mission/vision. Strategy gaps (17.5%) remain — competitive landscape is the critical missing piece.

readinessDimensions.label: Execution
readinessDimensions.summary: Brand narrative jumped to 85% with formal messaging. Channel strategy (45%) and referral tracking (20%) are the constraints.

readinessDimensions.label: Evidence
readinessDimensions.summary: Fundraising infrastructure exists but donor retention (15%) and grant pipeline (5%) lack measurement.

routes.title: Map competitive landscape
routes.shortDescription: No competitive mapping exists. Understanding alternatives families consider unlocks positioning clarity and referral strategy. (Suggested — needs client verification)

Needs client verification before starting.

Systematic measurement turns sentiment into strategy.
